criteria.A: A stages the complete target dataset in separate staging tables keyed by migration id, validates it there, then activates with one fenced batch that flips the installed-snapshot pointer and publishes staged rows; readers always resolve through the installed pointer.
criteria.B: B keeps installed and staged row versions side by side in the same tables, each variant tagged with its snapshot id; activation flips the installed-snapshot pointer so staged variants become visible, and superseded variants are retained or dropped per the plan directives.
criteria.C: C prepares target rows under a fresh model-namespace prefix in the same tables (copy-on-write per row) and activates by flipping a fenced per-model namespace alias; the old namespace is dropped after activation and readers resolve model names through the alias.
